headline: 线上验收通过 · 9.0 / 10
conclusion: 已复现 CPU 压力下的滚动延迟与空白。B 没有稳定改善；C 相比 B 在部分场景改善，但相比 A 收益不稳定，4× / 6× 快速滚动仍会空白。
details: 独立 critical agent 最终评分 9.0/10，通过。GitHub Pages 三页直达、刷新、切换、手动记录与 JSON 导出均通过；线上 48 项可见内容断言、渲染路径和生命周期等检查通过，无浏览器错误。报告实际数值、图片、6 份关键证据摘要及被测源码一致性已核对。完成 150 次主测试、45 次探索测试、9 组画面诊断与 7 种校准。评分评价实验与交付可信度，不代表性能问题已被修复。
liveEvidence: results/live/result.json and results/live-check/result.json record successful live checks before this final review status was written. Their embedded acceptance snapshot intentionally preserves that earlier stage. Final publication changes only report/evidence, retaining the identical renderer build.
scope: Synthetic Community display experiment; CPU throttling is not real low-end hardware certification. Custom editors, full-width/spanned rows and Enterprise features are excluded.
